description_en: Calls the ListDegradeRulesOfApp operation to query the degradation rules of an application
description_zh: 调用ListDegradeRulesOfApp接口获取应用降级规则
kebab_example: aliyun ahas-openapi list-degrade-rules-of-app --namespace default --app-name ahas-demo --page-index 1 --page-size 10 --ahas-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDegradeRulesOfApp

parameters.description_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, the value of this parameter is the application ID in EDAS. You can obtain the ID on the Basic Information page in Application Management of the EDAS console.

parameters.help_en: The application name. If the application is an EDAS application, the value of this parameter is the application ID in EDAS. You can obtain the ID on the Basic Information page in Application Management of the EDAS console
parameters.help_zh: 应用名，若为EDAS应用，则AppName为EDAS中的App ID，可在EDAS控制台“应用管理>基本信息”中查看对应的ID

parameters.description_en: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.
